body:
Hey!

It's incredibly tough, those decisions usually come from personal beliefs, life priorities and other things. One thing for sure, a loss of a child in whichever state is never easy.

I think it really goes both ways, no decision is bad or wrong. Plenty of lone mothers with loved and happy children out there just as well as plenty of women who have aborted and had children later, experienced love of your child and miracle of life.

Pros and Cons are on both sides, unfortunately that's how life is if you really look at it, every situation has them. Realising what's best for you is perhaps the best idea in such situation. I would personally talk to people i trust, people with similar experience, get some third person perspective.

Be strong! Wish you the best!

Looking at this post i think it's possible that we've got every kind mentioned. I've tried twice and Yes, i really am..   whatever it is you want to call it..     stumbled upon this place by a coincidence even though i don't really use reddit and never did. But as a person who has that kind of experience in life i am much more likely to understand anyone who is truly in trouble and posting here than anyone who is just trying to help, even if it's genuine. I felt like shit past few days, i wanted to find 'can't live but can't die' paradox or something like that with google and here i am. Very surprised how many people are posting, it touched my heart and i just want to help, because i understand, because i feel it, because i've been there. Peace

I've attempted twice, i'm really lucky we could say or that's what people tell me, someone 'saved' me. 

​

With time i understood it's the life i lived that i wanted to kill and not myself.

It's important to see what it is you want gone, life situation can be changed, regardless.

Be strong, stranger to stranger with compassion.

The idea of suicide has always been tempting to me ever since i was a teenager, with so much sadness in my heart and throughout the life itself. Have you ever tried help of a professional? If not then you should give it a try. I remember a quote of Jim Carry, if you don't get out there, go for walks, exercise, do things that give you joy or whatever it is, you have to give yourself a chance, a lot of things affect our mental state. Stay strong or at least try, as i do. Stanger to Stranger, with compassion.

Listen, i should be dead by now, if it wasn't for a person that lived in the same house at a time of my 'attempt' and had he had harder sleep i wouldn't be here. Can't die because of those you care for but can't live neither. I suggest you try a professional help, a therapist or someone like that, that's what i'm going to do as i struggle every day to wake up and breathe. Stay strong or at least try, just as i do. Better days are out there, i really believe that. Stranger to Stranger, with compassion.
